subject: public/sw.js — offline routing after the shelf moved to /api/shelf/
server: next start -p 3140, existing production build (.next BUILD_ID s2suEtPYtHjZZNcXpWMS4, basePath /gannenet)

defect.introduced_by: 9df6c5e — the 258 seed files moved from public/shelf/ into the gannenet-shelf bucket, and their catalog `file` fields became /api/shelf/<id>.<ext>
defect.measured: all 258 of 258 catalog.json entries now start with /api/shelf/ ; the service worker's isFile() still matched only /api/drive/
defect.consequence: the PREFETCH handler behind "שמירת התצוגה לאופליין" writes every saved file into the FILES cache, but no fetch path read FILES for /api/shelf/* — so the button's entire output was unreachable. Images (24 items) fell to isStatic and were looked up cache-first in SHELL, where the prefetch never put them; PDFs (234 items) fell through to networkFirst in SHELL. The app's stated promise, "עובד גם ללא אינטרנט", did not hold for the shelf.
defect.second_gap: isCatalog() matched only /api/drive-catalog, while app/shelf/page.tsx also fetches /api/catalog — the shelf's own 2,977-item listing had no stale-while-revalidate path.

fix.version: gannenet-v2 -> gannenet-v3, so activate() drops the caches built under the old routing. Safe to drop: the app is not deployed yet, so no user has an offline copy to lose.

cache_placement_after_one_request.note: FILES is the cache the bulk-save writes to; before the fix this same request landed in SHELL

offline.control_uncached_url: network FAILED: Failed to fetch — the network really was down
offline.conclusion: served from cache with no network

not_a_defect.byte_count_mismatch: the bucket object seed/16QLfhd7JsxdUZtVXgs33DhIXUZGT916_.jpg is 204,568 bytes but arrives as 29,278. It is a complete, valid JPEG (ff d8 ff … ff d9), and the direct bucket URL returns the identical 29,278 bytes from this machine — so NetFree re-compresses images in transit here, the same network path that returns 418 on PDF bodies from supabase.co (see 9df6c5e). Our route is byte-faithful to what it receives; the production server is not behind NetFree.

scope.migration: none — the database was read only (core.run_progress insert, storage.objects read)
scope.deploy: none. Vercel quota is still refused until ~2026-08-11T00:11Z (core.issues #83), and gannenet has no Vercel project yet.
scope.test_mode: no message and no charge left the machine
